_about: Hand-authored lore entries (ballads, candle rituals, empathy and sympathy rituals, glyphs, hymns, poems, rituals, runes, songs, evokes), merged into the generated pack by tools/extract/build_documents.py (apply_manual_content). Put entries under "entries", keyed by name, with the item's system fields. A new name is added, tagged sourcebook "Custom" unless you give one. A name his data already builds is ignored unless the entry says "_override": true, in which case only the fields you give are laid over his. In this pack names repeat between kinds ("Anger" is a song and a poem), so give "kind" on every entry: an override that names no kind is matched only while its name is unique, and a new entry with no kind takes the schema's default. Keys starting with _ are notes and never read. Full guide: docs/ADDING-CONTENT.md. Rebuild with: python tools/extract/build_documents.py --write

_example._note: An example of the shape. Copy entries from here into "entries" to use them.

Hearthsong.description: Listeners feel at home; +10% to Affinity checks with the singer while the song lasts.
